verdict.rationale: The only concrete spec in the pack is a family-level 'up to 48 TOPS NPU' figure for Core Ultra Series 2. It is not specific to the 258V and gives no test conditions. Every other Intel page cited is marketing language ('lightning speed', 'ultra-smooth FPS', 'smart power efficiency') rather than a spec sheet. Missing for 10: per-SKU clock speeds, TDP/power figures, memory type/capacity/speed support, AI TOPS broken out by engine with stated test conditions (precision, sparsity, clocks), and any independent corroboration of published specs.
